_explanation: Provenance record connecting every substantive claim or material used elsewhere in this package back to its location in input/paper.pdf, with an evidence label. Page numbers were approximated by mapping the pdftotext line-extraction offset for each cited passage to the PDF's form-feed page breaks; they are estimates of the printed page, not OCR bounding boxes. 'verbatim' = transcribed word-for-word from the PDF; 'reported' = the paper states this as a fact/finding but the package field paraphrases or summarizes it; 'derived' = computed or inferred by the package builder from paper-reported information, not printed directly; 'missing' = the paper does not state this and audit/missing_information.json has (or should have) a corresponding entry. No source outside input/paper.pdf was used -- see study.json 'external_sources'.
extraction_method: pdftotext -layout input/paper.pdf input/paper.txt for most sections; pdftotext -f 19 -l 22 input/paper.pdf - (no -layout) re-extracted for the two-column Appendix A questionnaire page, whose -layout output interleaved column order incorrectly. Both extractions were cross-checked against each other for the Appendix B/C boundary before transcribing verbatim text.
